schema_file: question_schema_v7_file layer with locators stimuli rubric and provenance.json
procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (54 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 4 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side: fill run prints 6-11, 13-16 (label 12 absent -> gap); 59 questions. Answer side: fill keys 6-15 run continuously, so keys 12-15 answer q013-q016 (left EMPTY with 'shifted numbering — see key N', 4 questions); T/F 17-25 aligned; [match block]; 27-59 aligned; q060 no key. Keys restate their questions. Difficulty per question: easy 35, average 5, difficult 19, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 51 (heading, LO) 52-55; A pdf 150 (heading 'Map Skills Questions', keys 1-8) 151-154.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-16 (no 12); s3 T/F q17-25; s4 '26. Match the following with correct answers (easy)' q26; s5 one mark q27-36 vsa; s6 two marks q37-44 sa; s7 three marks q45-52 sa; s8 four marks q53-60 la (heading tagged '(difficult)'; stems q53-60 untagged -> section_header).

KEY FORM: every key restates its question before the answer ('27. Which alphabet is used to show the north direction on the map? N'). The restatement is cut mechanically (the stem's last words located in the key line); answer.value = the answer part; answer_as_printed = the whole printed key line. Fill keys print the completed sentence -> stored verbatim as the fill value.

NUMBERING (ruled shape): label 12 absent on the question side; the fill keys run 6-15 continuously -> keys 12-15 answer q013-q016 (each key restates its question, so the coordinator's content check is direct). Default lane: EMPTY + 'shifted numbering — see key N'.

MAP QUESTIONS: q48 'Draw a map of your school and show the directions and locate the important places', q53 'Draw a map of the route…', q55 'Draw the design of your classroom from the grid system…' (keys '(To be drawn by student)'), q60 'Prepare a route map…' (no key) — no map printed on either side (figure inventory) -> sourceless: empty + 'no answer printed', no map block, no crop (Class-9 ruling).
q2 option A printed 'Answer' (flagged). q25 T/F key conflicts with the lesson's other keys on who first drew maps (flagged). q37 key: restated question + 3 bullets -> 3 steps.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_12.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
